question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Advantage
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word **"Advantage"** refers to a condition or circumstance that puts one in a favorable or superior position. (लाभ, फायदा).
 
• The correct word** "Boon" **means something that is beneficial, helpful, or a blessing. (वरदान, अनुग्रह).

Therefore, the **correct answer** is-** 'Boon'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2:** "Vital"** means absolutely necessary or important, essential.(आवश्यक).
 
• Option 3: **"Unfrock"** refers to the act of depriving a priest or minister of ecclesiastical status.(पादरी का पद छीनना).
 
• Option 4: **"Vengeance"** means punishment inflicted or retribution exacted for an injury or wrong. (प्रतिशोध).
